column3: MT 4:17. Close to the Hebrew; “guard your foot” is rendered “Walk prudently.”
MT 5:2. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “is known by.”
MT 5:5. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “of God” after “the messenger,” and renders “your voice” as “your excuse.”
MT 5:6. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “there is also.”
MT 5:8. The verse is difficult; NKJV renders “the profit of the land is for all; even the king is served from the field.”
MT 5:12. Close to the Hebrew; “a sick evil” is rendered “a severe evil.”
MT 5:13. Close to the Hebrew; “in an evil business” is rendered “through misfortune.”
MT 5:17. Close to the Hebrew; “his portion” is rendered “his heritage.”
MT 5:19. Close to the Hebrew; “he will not much remember” is rendered “he will not dwell unduly on.”
